name: Sugar Baby
overview: Darma works as a trusted driver and personal assistant to a powerful businessman. His loyalty is tested when he discovers that his name has been secretly used as a front for his boss's hidden assets. To uncover the truth and protect himself, Darma goes undercover as a Sugar Daddy and meets Susan, a charming Sugar Baby whose allure hides her own secrets. What begins as a calculated mission soon spirals into a dangerous game of lies and desire, where every move could cost Darma his career, his heart, and ultimately his life.
